title: Häufig gestellte Fragen: Verkaufen
description: Hier finden Sie Informationen über Verkaufen im Zusammenhang mit Autoauktionen bei Bidders Highway.
mainHtml:
Häufige Fragechevron_rightVerkaufen

Verkaufen

  • How do I know if you can sell my vehicle?

    The easiest way is to contact us directly. Submit your vehicle registration number here or send an email to support@biddershighway.com and we will get back to you shortly.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Do you sell all types of vehicles?

    Bidders Highway focuses solely on enthusiast and collector vehicles, and that is of course a broad term. The best thing to do is to contact us so we can have a dialogue to see if your vehicle fits our target group.

    Mehr erfahren

  • How do I know what my car is worth?

    It is of course good if you have an idea of ​​what you want to pay for your car. But valuation and pricing are always done in dialogue with us. We have experienced experts who can assess the value of your car depending on condition and model. Based on this, we can agree on a reasonable reservation price if you want it.

    Mehr erfahren

  • How do I contact you if I want to sell my car on Bidders Highway?

    It's really easy! Click the sell my car button on our website and a member of our team will contact you.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Can I have a reserve price on my auction?

    Yes, you may set a reserve price on your auction. If the bidding ends at a price lower than the reserve price, the car will not be sold. We are happy to help estimate an approximate price for the car if it's interesting to us, but remember that the market is always in control: The final price of your lot will be determined by what others are willing to pay for it.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Do I have to offer viewings of the car during the auction?

    No, your vehicle can stay in a garage or on your driveway while the auction is going on. The pictures and text are so detailed and complete in and of themselves. However, it may be a good idea to offer potential bidders a viewing of the car at a time that suits you if someone shows interest, but this is entirely up to you as the seller.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Do I get to approve my auction listing before the auction goes live?

    Yes. Before the auction is posted under “live” you will receive a link where you can preview all the information and see exactly how the auction will look when it is displayed publicly.

    Mehr erfahren

  • What happens when the auction is live?

    Once your scheduled auction starts, registered bidders are free to bid or ask you questions via our comments section. All questions are first reviewed and moderated by us to ensure good tone and relevance. It is up to each seller to answer any questions, so it is important that you actively follow your auction.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Can I advertise my car on other marketplaces while my auction is live?

    It is perfectly acceptable to place ads on other sites or in your social channels to attract visitors to your auction on Bidders Highway, but it is important that you do not specify a price so as not to disrupt the bidding. However, if Bidders Highway has set up an auction for you, we have exclusive rights to the sale, i.e. you cannot sell the car via another marketplace while you have an ongoi...

    Mehr erfahren

  • Can I bid on my own auction?

    No. Bidding on your own auction strictly prohibited, whether under your own name or someone else's. If we discover any fraudulent bidding, we will immediately close the auction and report the matter to the police.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Can I cancel my listing during an ongoing auction?

    Once you have approved your ad and it is published, it cannot be withdrawn. If you cancel a live auction anyway, you will be charged the buyer fee (based on your reservation price) according to our terms and conditions. The seller fee (2,995 SEK) is non-refundable as the services (valuation, ad production, photography and marketing) have already been delivered. More about this in our terms and ...

    Mehr erfahren

  • When will I receive the purchase price if my car is sold at auction?

    Once the auction has ended and there is a bid that meets the reserve price, Bidders Highway will make a digital introduction between you and the bidder with the winning bid so that you can agree on the desired payment method together.

    Mehr erfahren

  • What happens after the auction ends if my vehicle is sold?

    Once your vehicle has reached the desired reserve price and the auction is closed, Bidders Highway will first contact the buyer to charge the fee. Once this has been paid, we will make a digital introduction between buyer and seller to complete the payment and agree on the handover of the vehicle.

    Mehr erfahren

  • How is my vehicle documented and photographed?

    We will interview you about the condition of the car, and you are required to be as honest as possible. We will send out forms where you can describe what you know about the condition and history of the car. Detailed and well-crafted photo documentation is also incredibly important for a bidder to be able to bid on your car with confidence. Each auction should have an average of 100 or more pho...

    Mehr erfahren

  • What information do I need to provide about the car?

    The more information you can provide us with, the better. Basic documentation such as ownership details and registration certificate is mandatory, but if you can supplement it with receipts, service history, previous owners, etc. it is a big plus that makes your car much more attractive to potential bidders.

    Mehr erfahren

  • What happens if someone posts negative comments about my car?

    All comments are reviewed by our moderators, who ensures that the comments section is kept in good order. We will not approve derogatory or negative comments about the auctions that are irrelevant or unfounded. If you believe that a posted comment violates our commenting guidelines, please contact support@biddershighway.com and we will review the matter as soon as possible.

    Mehr erfahren

  • Will you help me photograph my vehicle?

    Yes. Photography is included in the sales fee (2,995 SEK). We book a photographer when we prepare your ad.

    Mehr erfahren

  • How much does it cost to sell with Bidders Highway?

    For the work done on your auction, we charge a fixed sales fee of SEK 2,995 (incl. VAT) per published auction. The fee includes: professional photography, valuation and advice, copy and layout of the ad, publication on Bidders Highway, exposure in newsletters and social channels, and publication on selected external advertising sites (e.g. mobile.de and Blocket). We also charge a variable fee o...

    Mehr erfahren

  • What happens if the bidding doesn't reach the reserve price?

    If the reserve is not met, the three highest bidders will have the opportunity to place a final bid or meet the reserve price after the auction. These bids are then valid for 24 hours so that we have the opportunity to convey this to the seller. It is always first come, first served and often things go quickly, so it is important to check your email and respond quickly. If the seller chooses to...

    Mehr erfahren

  • Can I contact the seller afterwards if the auction doesn't reach the reserve price?

    If an auction ends without reaching its reserve price, the three highest bidders will receive an email with the opportunity to place a final bid within 24 hours to reach the object's reserve price. Note, it is first come, first served and the seller can choose to accept new bids directly via Bidders Highway. If the bidders choose not to take advantage of this opportunity, the seller can either ...

    Mehr erfahren

  • Can I inspect the car during the auction?

    You can always ask in the comments section if it's possible to come and view the car, but it is entirely up to the seller to grant a viewing. Note that buyers and sellers are prohibited from initiating separate negotiations on site as the item is handled exclusively by Bidders Highway during an ongoing auction.

    Mehr erfahren

  • The sales fee (2,995 SEK, incl. VAT) includes:

    Mehr erfahren

  • Do you offer secure payments between buyer and seller?

    Buyers and sellers on our platform can choose to use Swiftcourt, an external and independent service for secure transactions. Swiftcourt is an escrow service that manages the payment between the parties and keeps the money safe until the transaction is completed. This is a convenient and voluntary support service to facilitate safer transactions between our users.
